fusions.name: Loose Ends
fusions.desc: Looses 5 strands at once, spread apart out to 6 tiles, each dealing 4 damage. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Matted Clump
fusions.desc: Spits a matted clump that hits the first enemy in its path for 6 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Snare Field
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangle Builds
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
